Mayor is there any long term or short health problems then need to worry about.

1) Public Health; 
2) Remediation

Dr. Davis, spoke on Health effects, even at low levels hydrogen sulfite (HS) are nose can pick up small doses of smell, symptoms will go away when you get away from the smell, if it persist contact your health provider.
Keep windows and doors closed, change filters in your homes.

Mayor, wants to know what is L.A. Co., is going to do about the problem? Pestrella - L.A. Co. is preparing for reimbursement to residents who expend funds to help alleviate the smell; any residence who want to be relocated reimbursement applies to them also.

Mayor - what about residents who cant afford to put funds out for relocation? 
Prestrella they are working to put cash up on the front end. Tomorrow morning a call center will be set up to take residents calls.

Can the city go out and purchase purifiers will the county reimburse the city if goes out and makes the purchase?

Hilton - will the County provide the assistance for housing $182.00 daily, meals and incidentals $62.00, like was provided to El Segundo.
Hilton - Carson wants equal treatment as El Segundo and El Segundo didn't have any conditions.

Hicks - what about the relief for the businesses in Carson, should they also contact the county for cost reimbursement? Pestrella - yes they should contact the county.

Dr. Davis - the county has strike teams going door to door to provide the citizens with information to safeguard against the odor.
Hilton - how have we gone a week but nothing is on social media or public health website.
Dr. Davis - we have public releases we are trying to have the people go to one location instead of multiple website for information.

Hicks - make the link on Carson's website so residents and businesses can get the information.
Landers - requested from Dr. Davis information that is being passed out door to door to the city.

Mayor - is there a time frame to rectify the problem in tomorrow public address.

Dr. Davis - treat this is a Bad Air Day.

Dr. Davis will make sure the  City receives a copy.
